status: Implemented prototype scenario assumptions; not validated vegetation growth forecasts
region: San Francisco pilot; transfer to other locations requires review
baseline_policy: Preserve observed NDVI. Missing baseline NDVI stays unknown.
trajectory_rule: N(t) = N_at_edit + (target - N_at_edit) * min(1, max(0, (t - edit_year) / response_years))
zero_duration_rule: Apply target immediately at edit_year when response_years == 0.
repeat_edit_rule: Use the final cover in each simulated year. Start from attained NDVI; recompute target against the immutable original baseline. Same-cover repaint is a no-op.

trees.label: Forest
trees.beta_basis: Rounded SF fractional-cover regression coefficient; not a measured mature-forest endpoint

grass.label: Grassland
grass.beta_basis: Rounded SF fractional-cover regression coefficient; only 47 cells >=70% grass in full study

crops.label: Cropland
crops.beta_basis: Uncalibrated placeholder; no adequately pure SF cropland cells in study

wetland.label: Wetland
wetland.beta_basis: Uncalibrated placeholder for vegetated wetland; no adequately pure SF wetland cells in study

bare.label: Bare land
bare.beta_basis: Uncalibrated placeholder; only 6 cells >=70% bare in full SF study

water.label: Water
water.beta_basis: Uncalibrated placeholder; water-dominated cells excluded from fitting

response_time_basis: ALL durations are chosen prototype assumptions. None were estimated by the NDVI experiment. Zero means the scenario action immediately replaces the surface, not that construction takes zero time.
degradation_policy: Do not reuse SOC percentage thresholds for NDVI or present this as the full Trends.Earth productivity assessment.

coefficient_provenance.experiment: SF 10.15 km study square centered at 37.76, -122.45; 145 m cells; 2020 fractional-cover regression, 2021 spatial holdout
coefficient_provenance.warning: Observational associations, not causal intervention effects; no fitted response durations. Only forest, grassland and artificial coefficients are taken from the fit.
